content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry, issued because precertification was not obtained before the service was rendered. The clinical indication documents a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. We request reconsideration and retroactive authorization based on this documented medical necessity."}
